it lacks the target's generic and injectable manufacturing business."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Sells medical devices and orthopedic biologics to surgeons and clinics, not prescription drugs through pharmacy and wholesale channels."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Sells branded household and personal care consumer products through mass retailers, not prescription drugs to pharmacies and hospitals."},{"label":"C6","good":true,"reason":"Develops and manufactures generic oral controlled-release tablets sold to pharma partners, closely matching the target's generic oral solids and extended-release drugs."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Primarily makes IV infusion devices and disposables for hospitals; injectable drugs are a minor line, so the core business differs."},{"label":"C8","good":true,"reason":"Brand owner of prescription buprenorphine products sold to wholesalers and pharmacies under DEA rules, overlapping the target's specialty branded drugs."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Mainly holds royalty interests in partner-made respiratory drugs, rather than manufacturing and selling generic or specialty prescription drugs."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Designs and makes surgical devices, implants and instruments for surgeons and hospitals, not prescription drugs."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Earns royalties from licensing its gastrointestinal drug to partners rather than manufacturing and selling prescription drugs itself."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Makes radiopharmaceutical diagnostic imaging agents for hospitals and nuclear pharmacies, a different product use from therapeutic generic and specialty drugs."},{"label":"C13","good":false,"reason":"Manufactures disposable medical devices like catheters and guidewires for hospitals, not prescription drugs."},{"label":"C14","good":true,"reason":"Manufactures and sells branded injectable pain drugs in-house to hospitals and clinics, overlapping the target's injectables and specialty branded drugs."},{"label":"C15","good":false,"reason":"Single oral cancer drug franchise, outsourced manufacturing and partner licensing, unlike the target's broad generic and injectable portfolio."},{"label":"C16","good":false,"reason":"Designs and makes medical devices such as catheters and anesthesia equipment for hospitals, not prescription drugs."}]}
